 Print Share Save The death has occurred of
 Johnny McEvoy
 Greystones, Wicklow / Banagher, Offaly Johnny McEvoy of Greystones, Co. Wicklow formerly Banagher, Co. Offaly.
 The McEvoy family are heartbroken to announce that it was the closing of the final curtain for this well-known and talented gentleman on Sunday November 8th 2026 at his home. 
Pre-deceased by his beloved wife and best friend Odette (née Matthews), parents John and Emily McEvoy, sisters Marie and Emily and brother Tom.
Remembered with love by his devoted children Jonathan and Alice, daughter-in-law Deirdre, son-in-law Ronan, adored grandchildren Kyle, Isabella and Cinéad, companion Mary, brothers-in-law Eamonn and Don, nieces, nephews, extended family, neighbours, circle of friends, his manager Darren, many fans, colleagues, the people who loved his music and those from the music world.
 The ceremony to celebrate Johnny’s life will be strictly private at his own request. 
 For those who would like to pay their respects his funeral cortège will leave the Greystones Harbour Marina on Saturday (November 14th) at 2.20pm driving along Cliff Road and Marine Road (Greystones Seafront) -a walk which he enjoyed daily. 
No flowers by request, donations in memory of Johnny to Dublin Simon Community.
 May he rest in peace. 
 Enquiries to Mark Kinsella Funeral Home.
 01 2810360 .
 Donations to Dublin Simon Community in Memory of Johnny McEvoy
